decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established trommel-screen knowledge and has shown positive early feedback, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal risk is minimal.
Mobile flail shredders are close to the firm's core mobile shredding and waste-processing expertise, enabling effective learning and low withdrawal risk.

Stationary electric fine shredding is less central to the firm's core mobile and waste-processing knowledge, so interpreting results and improving the product is harder, giving a moderate withdrawal risk.
The green-waste grinder fits the firm's existing biomass and composting customer base and related shredding knowledge, supporting assimilation and a low-to-moderate withdrawal risk.
Single-shaft pre-shredding is well embedded in the firm's waste-processing knowledge and has dedicated product support, enabling learning and low withdrawal risk.
